cards.descriptionEn: The study represents factor portfolio rules as Boolean functions and uses Walsh decomposition to split rule returns into single-signal exposures and signal-interaction exposures, linking interactions to turnover and trading costs. It provides a quantitative framework to predict rule turnover and explain why higher-order interaction portfolios trade more and earn lower net premia.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on U.S. stocks from 1973 to 2024; applicability to other markets, asset classes, and trading cost structures is untested. Trading costs are measured only by quoted spreads, omitting market impact and other real costs. Out-of-sample Sharpe improvements and model rejections depend on specific test specifications and should not be interpreted as implementable net-return strategies.
cards.titleEn: The Logic of Factor Portfolios: Boolean Rules, Interactions, and Trading Costs
keyPoints: 布尔规则表示可将因子组合收益分解为单信号暴露和信号间交互暴露，交集与并集规则具有相反的交互暴露。
交互项持久性低于组成信号，因此载荷高阶交互的规则换手更高；阈值实现比平滑实现交易更频繁。
1973—2024年美国股票数据中，预测与实现持久性相关系数不低于0.999，预测换手率与实现换手率回归斜率为1.02；1995—2024年单信号组合溢价超过价差成本的占58%，双信号和三信号交互组合分别占24%和6%。
cards.description: 该研究提出用布尔函数表示因子组合规则，并通过Walsh分解将规则收益拆分为单信号暴露和信号间交互暴露，进而揭示交互暴露与换手率、交易成本的关系。新方法能预测规则换手率，并解释为何高阶交互组合交易成本更高、净溢价更低，为因子组合设计提供了可量化的成本评估框架。
cards.title: 因子组合的逻辑：布尔规则与交互交易成本
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架将因子组合的收益来源与交易成本通过同一组布尔系数联系起来，使研究者能在设计阶段预测换手率和成本侵蚀，并解释为何交互组合虽能提升样本外夏普比率却难以覆盖交易成本。对因子组合构建和成本评估具有方法学参考价值。
cards.summary: 将因子组合规则写成布尔函数后，可用Walsh分解将收益拆为单信号暴露与交互暴露；交互项持久性低于其组成信号，因此高交互规则换手更高。作者用1973—2024年美国股票数据验证预测的持久性与换手率几乎完全匹配，并发现1995—2024年间单信号组合中绝对溢价超过报价价差的占比达58%，而双信号和三信号交互组合分别仅24%和6%。样本外，交互组合能提升单信号切点组合的夏普比率，并拒绝六因子模型，而传统排序不能。
keyPointsEn: Boolean rule representation decomposes factor portfolio returns into single-signal exposures and signal-interaction exposures, with intersection and union rules having opposite interaction exposures.
Interactions are less persistent than component signals, so rules with higher-order interactions have higher turnover; threshold implementations trade more than smooth ones.

In U.S. stocks 1973–2024, predicted and realized persistence correlate at least 0.999 and predicted turnover matches realized turnover with a slope of 1.02; over 1995–2024, 58% of single-signal portfolios have premia above spread costs versus 24% for two-signal and 6% for three-signal interaction portfolios.
cards.summaryEn: Factor portfolio rules written as Boolean functions can be decomposed via Walsh decomposition into single-signal exposures and interaction exposures; interactions are less persistent than their component signals, so rules loading on higher-order interactions trade more. Using U.S. stocks from 1973 to 2024, the authors find predicted and realized persistence correlate at least 0.999, predicted turnover matches realized turnover with a slope of 1.02, and over 1995–2024, 58% of single-signal portfolios have absolute premia above quoted-spread costs versus 24% for two-signal and 6% for three-signal interaction portfolios. Out of sample, interaction portfolios raise the Sharpe ratio of single-signal tangency portfolios and reject a six-factor model that conventional sorts do not reject.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework links return sources and trading costs of factor portfolios through the same Boolean coefficients, enabling researchers to predict turnover and cost erosion at the design stage and to explain why interaction portfolios may raise out-of-sample Sharpe ratios yet struggle to cover trading costs. It offers methodological reference for factor portfolio construction and cost evaluation.
cards.limitations: 证据基于美国股票1973—2024年样本，结论对其他市场、资产类别和交易成本结构的适用性尚未验证；交易成本仅以报价价差衡量，未涵盖市场冲击等实际成本；交互组合的样本外夏普提升和模型拒绝结果依赖特定检验设定，不能直接解释为可实施的净收益策略。
cards.originalTitle: The Logic of Factor Portfolios: Boolean Rules, Interactions, and Trading Costs

cards.descriptionEn: The study tests whether reinforcement-learning execution policies normalized by microstructure invariance can transfer zero-shot to unseen assets, markets, and asset classes; its value lies in quantifying the feasibility and limits of cross-asset generalization and exposing the misleading nature of common transfer-gap metrics.
cards.limitationsEn: The study relies on order-by-order replay of specific public Nasdaq data and involves only two actions: waiting in queue and crossing the spread; transfer gains are on the order of basis points and do not cover unseen spread regimes; synthetic market and pendulum experiments only illustrate metric flaws and do not generalize to other assets or execution scenarios; fee structure changes and market impact are not addressed.
cards.titleEn: Does a Trading Policy Need to Know What It Trades? Microstructure Invariance and Zero-Shot Transfer of Execution Policies
keyPoints: 仅以近期交易率、交易规模、价差和最小变动价位为输入的策略，与训练中见过该股票的策略相比，每股成本差距小于0.015个价差，且股票自身历史无额外帮助。
在平均成本（不含费用）上，不变单位表示优于原始单位、z分数和资产描述符，但优势不足一个基点，且大部分优势来自信息与共同成本尺度。
近零迁移差距是弱证据：池化比较器仅能检测差表示损失的一小部分，该现象在合成市场和倒立摆任务中被复现。
cards.description: 该研究检验了基于微观结构不变性归一化的强化学习执行策略能否在未见资产、市场及资产类别上零样本迁移；其价值在于量化了跨资产泛化的可能性与边界，并指出常用迁移差距指标的误导性。
cards.title: 交易策略需知交易标的吗？微观结构不变性与执行策略零样本迁移
cards.whyItMatters: 为执行算法的跨资产泛化提供了可量化的证据边界：微观结构不变性归一化能带来有限但可测的迁移优势，但不足以消除价差机制变化的影响。同时，研究警示不应将低迁移差距误读为表示优越，这对策略评估方法论有直接意义。
cards.summary: 研究在纳斯达克逐笔回放数据上训练策略，在2019年954只股票上学习，而后在2020-21年1964只、2025-26年2629只未见股票、加密交易对及第二交易所上零样本评估。作者报告不变单位表示在平均成本上略优于原始单位、z分数和资产描述符，但优势不足一个基点，且无表示能外推至未见价差机制。文章强调近零迁移差距不能证明表示正确，因为池化比较器仅能检测差表示损失的一小部分。
keyPointsEn: A policy seeing only recent trade rate, trade size, spread, and tick costs within 0.015 spreads per share of a policy trained with the stock included, with the stock's own history offering no help.
In mean cost before fees, invariant units beat raw units, z-scores, and asset descriptors, but by under a basis point; most of the advantage comes from information and a common cost scale.
A near-zero transfer gap is weak evidence: a pooled comparator detects only a small share of a poor representation's loss, confirmed in synthetic markets and on pendulums.
cards.summaryEn: Using exact order-by-order replay of Nasdaq data, policies are trained on 954 stocks in 2019 and evaluated unchanged on 1,964 unseen stocks in 2020-21, 2,629 stocks in 2025-26, crypto pairs, and a second exchange. The authors report that invariant units modestly outperform raw units, z-scores, and asset descriptors in mean cost, but by under a basis point, and no representation extrapolates to unseen spread regimes. They emphasize that a near-zero transfer gap is weak evidence of a correct representation, because a pooled comparator detects only a small share of what a poor representation loses.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides quantified evidence boundaries for cross-asset generalization of execution algorithms: microstructure-invariance normalization yields limited but measurable transfer gains, yet does not eliminate the impact of changing spread regimes. It also warns against misreading low transfer gaps as representation superiority, with direct implications for policy evaluation methodology.
cards.limitations: 研究基于特定公开纳斯达克数据的逐笔回放，仅涉及等待队列与跨价差两种动作；迁移优势以基点计且不覆盖未见价差机制；合成市场与倒立摆实验仅用于说明指标缺陷，不能推广至其他资产或执行场景；未涉及费用结构变化或市场冲击等复杂因素。
cards.originalTitle: Does a Trading Policy Need to Know What It Trades? Microstructure Invariance and Zero-Shot Transfer of Execution Policies

cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a framework that patches a deployed gradient-boosted tree fraud detector without modifying it: an LLM proposes rules around features underweighted by SHAP, which are screened for empirical support and calibrated into an additive, reversible log-lift overlay. Novelty lies in pooling three diverse LLM backbones to reduce variance and yielding readable amendment predicates.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to one real e-commerce fraud detector and a public benchmark of seven designed bias-shift variants; single-LLM effects are unstable across datasets and pooling may trade peak gain for worst-case stability; long-term production impact, rule maintenance cost, and adversarial adaptation risks are not reported.
cards.titleEn: Reversible LLM Rule Overlay Patches Blind Spots in Frozen Fraud Detectors
keyPoints: 框架不修改原模型，而是用LLM生成针对SHAP欠权重特征的规则，经筛选和校准形成可加、可逆的对数提升叠加。
在真实电商欺诈检测器上，叠加层平均提升2.26%等精确率召回和1.60%等召回率精确率；继续训练则退化。
单LLM增益高方差且跨数据集反转，池化三个异构LLM以等权logit平均获得更稳定的最差情况。
cards.description: 提出一种不修改已部署梯度提升树欺诈检测器的框架：由LLM围绕SHAP显示被低估的特征提出规则，经经验支持筛选并校准为可加、可逆的对数提升叠加。其新在于池化三个不同LLM骨干以降低方差，并给出可读的修补规则。
cards.title: 可逆规则叠加：不修改模型修补欺诈检测盲点
cards.whyItMatters: 为已部署且不宜重训练的欺诈检测器提供一种可逆、可读的补丁机制，在不改动原模型的前提下修补盲点，并展示了LLM规则与集成策略在工业表格任务中的潜在价值。
cards.summary: 工业表格欺诈分类中梯度提升树仍为最优，但训练好的模型存在盲点，而重训练部署模型不总是安全。作者提出框架：让LLM围绕SHAP标记的欠权重特征生成规则，将噪声规则池筛选经验支持后校准为可加、可逆的对数提升叠加，在生产截止点运行。作者报告在真实电商欺诈检测器上叠加层取得平均召回和精确率增益，继续训练即使调参也退化；但单LLM效果高方差且跨数据集反转，故采用三个异构骨干等权logit平均以换取有界最差情况。
keyPointsEn: The framework leaves the original model unchanged, using LLM-generated rules targeting SHAP-underweighted features, screened and calibrated into an additive, reversible log-lift overlay.
On a real e-commerce fraud detector, the overlay yields average +2.26% recall at equal precision and +1.60% precision at equal recall; continued training regresses.
Single-LLM gains are high-variance and invert across datasets; pooling three diverse LLMs with equal-weight logit averaging stabilizes the worst case.
cards.summaryEn: Gradient-boosted trees remain state-of-the-art for industrial tabular fraud classification, but even well-trained models have blind spots and retraining deployed models is not always safe. The authors propose a framework where LLMs generate rules anchored on features underweighted by SHAP, the noisy rule pool is screened for empirical support and calibrated into an additive, reversible log-lift overlay at the production cut-off. They report average recall and precision gains on a real e-commerce fraud detector where continued training regresses; single-LLM gains are high-variance and invert across datasets, so three diverse backbones are pooled via equal-weight logit averaging to bound the worst case.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a reversible, readable patch mechanism for deployed fraud detectors that are unsafe to retrain, fixing blind spots without altering the original model, and demonstrates the potential of LLM rules and ensembling for industrial tabular tasks.
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于一个真实电商欺诈检测器和七个设计偏差变体基准；单LLM效果跨数据集不稳定，池化虽改善最差情况但可能牺牲峰值增益；未报告长期生产影响、规则维护成本或对抗适应风险。
cards.originalTitle: Patching the Blind Spots: Reversible LLM Rule Overlay for Frozen Fraud Detectors

cards.descriptionEn: This study uses Lloyd's syndicate data to propose a method for transferring claims development scenarios across portfolio sizes, revealing the impact of size scaling on tail risk estimates and providing an inspectable tool for scenario comparability in stress testing.
cards.limitationsEn: The measured movement is not a pure measure of opening-reserve deterioration; tail transfer understates risk for the smallest books; square-root scaling has lower loss but more misses for large books; results depend on the fitted model and serve as a tool for scenario comparability, not a calibrated capital quantile or next-year forecast.
cards.titleEn: Portfolio-aware scenario transfer of reserve movements: evidence from Lloyd's syndicates
keyPoints: 离散度随储备规模显著下降，基于规模的缩放对留出辛迪加的预测远优于单一市场缩放。
迁移后的99.5%分位数在最小储备规模四分位中低估风险：158个留出观测中6个超过阈值，预期仅0.79个。
平方根缩放在99%和99.5%分位数上描述性留出pinball损失更低，但在最大账簿中遗漏更多。
cards.description: 该研究基于劳合社辛迪加数据，提出按组合规模迁移索赔进展情景的方法，并揭示规模缩放对尾部风险估计的影响，为压力测试的情景可比性提供可检验工具。
cards.title: 劳合社辛迪加储备变动的情景迁移方法
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法提升了跨组合规模压力情景的可比性和可检验性，有助于监管与机构在情景分析中避免因规模差异导致的误导性风险估计。
cards.summary: 研究利用2015-2024年117个劳合社辛迪加的632个辛迪加-年观测，估计如何将索赔进展变动情景在不同规模组合间迁移。发现离散度随储备规模显著下降，基于规模的缩放预测留出辛迪加优于单一市场缩放。但迁移后的上尾低估最小账簿风险，且贡献在于情景可比性而非校准资本分位数。
keyPointsEn: Dispersion falls materially with reserve size, and size-based scaling predicts held-out syndicates far better than a single market scale.
The transferred 99.5th percentile understates risk in the smallest reserve-size quartile: six of 158 held-out observations exceeded it, against 0.79 expected.
Square-root scaling has descriptively lower held-out pinball loss at 99% and 99.5%, though with more misses among the largest books.
cards.summaryEn: Using 632 syndicate-year observations from 117 Lloyd's syndicates over 2015-2024, the study estimates how to transfer claims development movement scenarios between portfolios of different sizes. Dispersion falls materially with reserve size, and size-based scaling predicts held-out syndicates far better than a single market scale. However, the transferred upper tail understates the smallest books, and the contribution is scenario comparability, not a calibrated capital quantile.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method enhances the comparability and inspectability of stress scenarios across portfolio sizes, helping regulators and institutions avoid misleading risk estimates due to size differences in scenario analysis.
cards.limitations: 所测变动不是纯期初储备恶化指标；尾部迁移在最小账簿中低估风险；平方根缩放虽损失更低但大账簿遗漏更多；结果依赖于拟合模型，且仅为情景可比性工具，非校准资本分位数或次年预测。
cards.originalTitle: Portfolio-aware scenario transfer of reserve movements: evidence from Lloyd's syndicates

cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes Isotonic Quantile Regression Averaging (iQRA), which uses stochastic order constraints as a hyperparameter-free regularization to reduce computational complexity while maintaining forecast accuracy; in two European day-ahead electricity market forecasting studies, iQRA and its smoothed variant rank among top methods for reliability and sharpness and improve the economic value of battery arbitrage trading.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from two European day-ahead electricity market forecasting studies and an author-designed battery arbitrage evaluation, without covering other markets or real-time markets; comparison is not exhaustive against all postprocessing methods; conclusions should not be directly extrapolated as investment advice.
cards.titleEn: Isotonic Quantile Regression Averaging for Uncertainty Quantification of Electricity Price Forecasts
keyPoints: iQRA 引入随机序约束作为无超参数正则化机制，降低计算复杂度并保持竞争性预测精度。
在两次欧洲日前电力市场预测研究中，iQRA 及其平滑变体在可靠性和锐度上排名靠前。
平滑 iQRA 在可靠性上优于面向覆盖的共形预测，电池套利评估显示领先概率方法实现最高单笔交易利润。
cards.description: 该研究提出等渗分位数回归平均（iQRA），通过随机序约束作为无超参数正则化，降低计算复杂度并保持预测精度；在两次欧洲日前电力市场预测中，iQRA 及平滑变体在可靠性和锐度上排名靠前，并提升电池套利交易的经济价值。
cards.title: 等渗分位数回归平均用于电价预测不确定性量化
cards.whyItMatters: 概率预测有助于评估和缓解数据驱动决策的风险，尤其在电价波动剧烈的市场；iQRA 提供可扩展的无超参数变量选择，适合能源市场实际决策支持系统。
cards.summary: 论文提出 iQRA，一种计算高效的 QRA 等渗变体，利用随机序约束实现无超参数正则化，并推广到平滑 QRA。在两次欧洲日前电力市场预测研究中，iQRA 及其平滑变体在可靠性和锐度上表现优异，平滑 iQRA 的可靠性甚至优于面向覆盖的共形预测。作者通过电池套利评估表明，领先的概率预测方法实现最高单笔交易利润，概率风险控制提升交易决策的经济价值。
keyPointsEn: iQRA introduces stochastic order constraints as a hyperparameter-free regularization mechanism that reduces computational complexity while maintaining competitive forecast accuracy.
In two European day-ahead electricity market forecasting studies, iQRA and its smoothed variant rank among top methods for reliability and sharpness.
Smoothed iQRA outperforms coverage-oriented conformal prediction in reliability, and battery arbitrage evaluation shows leading probabilistic methods achieve the highest profit per trade.
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes iQRA, a computationally efficient isotonic variant of QRA that uses stochastic order constraints as a hyperparameter-free regularization mechanism and extends to smoothed QRA. In two European day-ahead electricity market forecasting studies, iQRA and its smoothed variant perform well in reliability and sharpness, with smoothed iQRA outperforming coverage-oriented conformal prediction in reliability. A battery arbitrage evaluation shows that leading probabilistic methods achieve the highest profit per trade and that probabilistic risk control improves the economic value of trading decisions.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Probabilistic forecasting helps assess and mitigate risks of data-driven decisions, especially in volatile electricity markets; iQRA offers scalable hyperparameter-free variable selection suitable for practical decision-support systems in energy markets.
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自两次欧洲日前电力市场预测研究及作者设计的电池套利评估，未涉及其他市场或实时市场；未与其他所有后处理方法进行穷尽比较；结论不宜直接外推为投资建议。
cards.originalTitle: Isotonic Quantile Regression Averaging for uncertainty quantification of electricity price forecasts

cards.descriptionEn: Proposes a bivariate discrete-time BINAR(1) framework to jointly capture the dynamic dependence, temporal persistence, and correlation direction between claim financial costs and repair-related carbon emissions; uses external emission factors and parts cost data to operationalize carbon footprint under new-parts versus circular reused-parts repair pathways, and conducts scenario analyses on the joint implications of higher reused-parts acceptance.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions rely on externally sourced emission factors, parts cost assumptions, and model-based scenario simulations, without reported empirical estimation or causal identification; the joint benefit magnitude depends on the BINAR(1) dependence structure and persistence specification, and the impact of PIEC acceptance changes may be subject to unobserved factors and parameter uncertainty, so extrapolation requires caution.
cards.titleEn: Joint modelling of financial cost and carbon footprint in motor insurance claims: a BINAR(1) decision framework for circular auto parts adoption
keyPoints: BINAR(1)双变量离散时间框架联合刻画理赔成本与碳足迹的时间持续性、交叉依赖及相关方向。
以外部排放因子和配件成本数据，将单次索赔碳足迹操作化为新件与循环再利用件两种维修路径。
情景分析表明更高PIEC接受率可同时降低预期排放与平均理赔成本，但幅度依赖依赖结构与持续性。
cards.description: 提出一个双变量离散时间BINAR(1)框架，同时刻画理赔财务成本与维修碳排放的动态依赖、时间持续性和相关方向；用外部排放因子与配件成本数据量化新件与循环再利用件两条维修路径，并通过情景分析展示提高再利用件接受率对预期成本和排放的联合影响。
cards.title: 汽车保险理赔中财务成本与碳足迹的BINAR(1)联合建模
cards.whyItMatters: 为保险公司提供一个透明、可复现的工具，用于评估维修政策杠杆，在保留显式随机风险视角的同时，将理赔运营与脱碳目标对齐。
cards.summary: 论文构建BINAR(1)依赖结构，联合建模车险理赔财务成本与维修相关碳足迹，允许时间持续性、交叉依赖及正负相关。基于外部排放因子与配件成本，将索赔碳足迹操作化为新件与循环再利用件（PIEC）两条维修路径，并进行PIEC接受率变动的情景分析。情景结果显示，提高PIEC接受率可同时降低预期排放与平均理赔成本，联合收益幅度取决于BINAR(1)过程捕捉的依赖结构与持续性；这是作者基于模型情景的结论，并非实证因果识别。
keyPointsEn: The BINAR(1) bivariate discrete-time framework jointly captures temporal persistence, cross-dependence, and correlation direction between claim costs and carbon footprint.
Using external emission factors and parts cost data, it operationalizes per-claim carbon footprint under new-parts and circular reused-parts repair pathways.
Scenario analyses indicate higher PIEC acceptance can simultaneously lower expected emissions and average claim cost, but the magnitude depends on the dependence structure and persistence.
cards.summaryEn: The paper builds a BINAR(1) dependence structure to jointly model motor insurance claim financial costs and repair-related carbon footprint, allowing temporal persistence, cross-dependence, and positive/negative correlation. Using externally sourced emission factors and parts cost information, it operationalizes claim carbon footprint under two repair pathways—new parts versus circular-economy reused parts (PIEC)—and conducts scenario analyses varying PIEC acceptance rates. Scenario results show that higher PIEC acceptance can simultaneously reduce expected emissions and average claim cost, with the magnitude depending on the dependence structure and persistence captured by the BINAR(1) process; these are model-based scenario findings, not empirical causal identification.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers insurers a transparent, reproducible tool to evaluate repair-policy levers and align claims operations with decarbonization targets while retaining an explicit stochastic risk perspective.
cards.limitations: 结论基于外部排放因子与配件成本假设及模型情景模拟，未报告实证数据估计或因果识别；联合收益幅度依赖BINAR(1)依赖结构与持续性设定，PIEC接受率变化的影响可能受未观测因素与参数不确定性约束，外推需谨慎。
cards.originalTitle: Joint modelling of financial cost and carbon footprint in motor insurance claims: a BINAR(1) decision framework for circular auto parts adoption

cards.descriptionEn: This video provides an in-depth look at DeepSeek Harness (DSH) and its Cordis plugin system, showing how plugins compose tools, system prompts, and even the agent loop, with hands-on examples of writing and loading custom plugins.
cards.limitationsEn: The video is a technical demo and architecture overview; it provides no quantitative performance comparisons, validation in quantitative research scenarios, or evidence from large-scale production environments. All conclusions are limited to the scope of the DSH and Cordis demonstrations.
cards.titleEn: DeepSeek Harness Open-Source Framework: Everything as Plugins, Including Custom Agent Loops
keyPoints: DSH 基于 Cordis 插件系统，将 Agent 循环、工具和系统提示全部作为插件实现。
Cordis 通过服务、依赖注入、事件和注册追踪连接应用各组件，并在插件卸载时安全清理。
视频演示了编写 greet 工具、bash 守卫和 hello 插件，并通过 dsh web --patch 及 npm 包加载到桌面应用。
cards.description: 该视频深入解析 DeepSeek 开源 Agent 框架 DSH 及其底层插件系统 Cordis，展示如何通过插件机制组合工具、系统提示乃至 Agent 循环，并演示编写和加载自定义插件。
cards.title: DeepSeek Harness 开源框架：一切皆插件，含自定义 Agent 循环
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架的完全插件化设计可能降低构建和定制 AI Agent 的门槛，允许开发者复用或替换任意组件，包括不使用模型的 Agent 循环。
cards.summary: 视频介绍了 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）这一基于 Cordis 插件系统构建的开源 Agent 框架，其核心理念是“一切皆插件”，涵盖 Agent 循环、工具和系统提示。作者解释了 Cordis 如何通过服务、依赖注入、事件和注册追踪来实现插件组合与安全卸载，并通过编写示例插件（greet 工具、bash 守卫、hello 插件）和加载到 Electron 桌面应用来演示实际用法。结论是 DSH 的插件化设计让用户能灵活扩展乃至替换 Agent 循环，例如创建一个不调用模型的循环。
keyPointsEn: DSH is built on the Cordis plugin system, implementing the agent loop, tools, and system prompt as plugins.
Cordis connects application components via services, dependency injection, events, and registration tracking, safely cleaning up when plugins unmount.
The demo writes a greet tool, a bash guard, and a hello plugin, then loads them via `dsh web --patch` and npm packages into the desktop app.
cards.summaryEn: The video introduces DeepSeek Harness (DSH), an open-source agent framework built on the Cordis plugin system under the principle that everything is a plugin, including the agent loop, tools, and system prompt. It explains how Cordis uses services, dependency injection, events, and registration tracking for plugin composition and safe cleanup, and demonstrates writing sample plugins (a greet tool, a bash guard, and a hello plugin) and loading them into the Electron desktop app. The conclusion is that DSH's plugin-based design enables flexible extension or replacement of the agent loop, such as creating a loop that never calls a model.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The fully plugin-based design could lower the barrier to building and customizing AI agents, allowing developers to reuse or replace any component, including an agent loop that does not call a model.
cards.limitations: 视频仅为技术演示和架构介绍，未提供量化性能对比、量化研究场景验证或大规模生产环境证据；所有结论限于 DSH 与 Cordis 的演示范围。
cards.originalTitle: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) EXPLAINED | Everything Is a Plugin

cards.descriptionEn: Tyche introduces a one-step conditional flow model that maps Gaussian noise directly to future weather states in a single function evaluation, generating probabilistic forecast ensembles that match or exceed multi-step diffusion baselines and the ECMWF IFS ensemble on ERA5.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from the arXiv abstract, without full experimental details, statistical significance tests, or independent reproduction; evaluation is limited to ERA5 reanalysis at 1.5° and 6-hour resolution, without higher resolution, real-time observational initialization, or extreme-event-specific assessment; the scope and fairness of the comparison with ECMWF IFS require the full paper; the claim of reducing operational large-ensemble costs is an author inference, not a directly measured conclusion.
cards.titleEn: Tyche: One-Step Flow Model for Efficient Probabilistic Weather Forecasting
keyPoints: Tyche 用目的地感知的平均速度流建模条件预报分布，单次函数评估直接生成未来天气状态。
为在高维地球物理场中学习单步传输，作者提出 JVP 正则化整流目标，强制源与目标流时间步之间的一致性。
在 ERA5 1.5°、6 小时分辨率上，单步 Tyche 的预报技巧与校准度匹配或超过多步生成基线及 ECMWF IFS 集合。
cards.description: Tyche 提出单步条件流模型，将高斯噪声直接映射到未来天气状态，仅需一次函数评估即可生成概率预报集合，在 ERA5 数据集上预报技巧与校准度达到或超过多步扩散模型及 ECMWF IFS 集合预报。
cards.title: 一步流模型 Tyche 实现高效概率天气预报
cards.whyItMatters: 概率天气预报需要校准的集合分布，但扩散类集合预报的推理成本随预报时效、集合规模和去噪步数增长。Tyche 以单次函数评估生成集合成员，若其报告的性能可复现，则有望显著降低业务化大集合预报的计算开销，为高频、大集合概率预报提供更可行的技术路径。
cards.summary: 输入摘要报告了 Tyche 模型，其核心是用目的地感知的平均速度流实现单步条件生成，并辅以 JVP 正则化整流目标和基于 rollout 的微调阶段。作者在 1.5°、6 小时间隔的 ERA5 数据上报告，单次函数评估的 Tyche 在预报技巧与校准上匹配或超越多步生成基线及 ECMWF IFS 集合。需要区分的是：单步高效推理与基准对比是摘要陈述的事实，而“可降低大集合业务成本”属于作者对应用价值的推断。
keyPointsEn: Tyche models the conditional forecast distribution with a destination-aware average-velocity flow, producing future weather states in one function evaluation.

To learn one-step transport in high-dimensional geophysical fields, the authors propose a JVP-regularized rectification objective enforcing temporal consistency across source and destination flow timesteps.
On ERA5 at 1.5° and 6-hour resolution, one-step Tyche matches or exceeds the forecast skill and calibration of multi-step generative baselines and the ECMWF IFS ensemble.
cards.summaryEn: The input abstract reports Tyche, a one-step conditional flow model using a destination-aware average-velocity flow, a JVP-regularized rectification objective, and rollout-based finetuning. On ERA5 at 1.5° and 6-hour resolution, the authors report that Tyche with a single function evaluation matches or exceeds the forecast skill and calibration of multi-step generative baselines and the ECMWF IFS ensemble. The efficiency and benchmark comparisons are stated facts in the abstract, whereas reducing operational ensemble costs is the authors' inferred implication.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Probabilistic weather forecasting requires calibrated ensemble distributions, but diffusion-based ensemble forecasters scale inference cost with forecast horizon, ensemble size, and denoising steps. Tyche generates ensemble members with a single function evaluation; if its reported performance is reproducible, it could substantially reduce the computational cost of operational large ensembles and make high-frequency, large-ensemble probabilistic forecasting more feasible.
cards.limitations: 证据仅来自 arXiv 摘要，未提供完整实验细节、统计显著性检验或独立复现；评估限于 ERA5 再分析数据在 1.5° 和 6 小时分辨率下的表现，未涉及更高分辨率、实时观测初始化或极端事件专项评估；与 ECMWF IFS 的对比范围与公平性需查阅全文确认；摘要中“降低大集合业务成本”属作者推断，非直接测量结论。
cards.originalTitle: Tyche: One Step Flow for Efficient Probabilistic Weather Forecasting

On a synthetic dataset, the framework reports 98% traceability of numerical findings, validation of 214 of 216 po
cards.limitationsEn: Evaluation is based solely on a synthetic healthcare claims dataset and has not been validated on real-world data; policy citation validation achieved 214/216 rather than full validation; the 98% traceability and sensitive identifier removal results are reported values from this synthetic experiment, and generalization ability and clinical/operational deployment effects remain unclear.
cards.titleEn: Agentic AI Framework for Healthcare Claim Denial Analysis
keyPoints: 框架由拒付风险预测、风险因素识别、诊断-操作-药物代码关系分析、反事实分析等专用智能体模块组成。
集成基于医疗政策文档的混合上下文RAG管线与专职HIPAA合规智能体，以支持政策溯源与隐私保护。
在合成理赔数据集上，报告数值发现98%可追溯、216条政策引用中214条验证通过、移除全部280个敏感标识符且不改变底层分析。
cards.description: 该研究提出一个模块化智能体AI框架，用于医保理赔拒付分析，整合拒付风险预测、风险因素识别、诊疗用药代码关系分析与反事实分析，并引入基于政策文档的混合上下文RAG与HIPAA合规智能体。在合成数据集上，框架实现数值发现98%可追溯、216条政策引用中214条验证通过、移除全部280个敏感标识符且不改变底层分析。
cards.title: 基于智能体AI的医保理赔拒付分析框架
cards.whyItMatters: 医保理赔拒付带来显著财务与行政负担，该工作探索将智能体AI、政策检索与隐私合规机制结合，为可解释、政策感知且隐私保护的拒付决策支持提供了一种模块化设计思路。
cards.summary: 论文提出一个模块化智能体AI框架，用于医保理赔拒付分析，包含风险预测、风险因素识别、代码关系分析、反事实分析等专用智能体，并集成基于政策文档的混合上下文RAG与HIPAA合规智能体。在合成医保理赔数据集上，框架报告数值发现98%可追溯、216条政策引用中214条验证通过、移除全部280个敏感标识符且未改变底层分析。作者认为这些结果展示了智能体AI在可解释、政策感知且隐私保护的理赔拒付管理方面的潜力，但证据仅来自合成数据。
keyPointsEn: The framework consists of specialized agent modules for denial risk prediction, risk factor identification, diagnosis-procedure-medication code relationship analysis, and counterfactual analysis.
It integrates a hybrid contextual RAG pipeline grounded in healthcare policy documents and a dedicated HIPAA compliance agent to support policy traceability and privacy protection.

On a synthetic claims dataset, it reports 98% traceability of numerical findings, validation of 214 of 216 policy citations, and removal of all 280 identified sensitive identifiers without altering the underlying analysis.
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes a modular agentic AI framework for healthcare claim denial analysis, comprising specialized agents for risk prediction, risk factor identification, code relationship analysis, and counterfactual analysis, integrated with a hybrid contextual RAG pipeline grounded in policy documents and a HIPAA compliance agent. On a synthetic healthcare claims dataset, the framework reports 98% traceability of numerical findings, validation of 214 of 216 policy citations, and removal of all 280 identified sensitive identifiers without modifying the underlying analysis. The authors view these results as evidence of the potential of agentic AI for explainable, policy-aware, and privacy-preserving claim denial management, though the evidence comes only from synthetic data.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Healthcare claim denials impose significant financial and administrative burdens; this work explores combining agentic AI, policy retrieval, and privacy compliance mechanisms to offer a modular design for explainable, policy-aware, and privacy-preserving denial decision support.
cards.limitations: 评估仅基于合成医保理赔数据集，未在真实世界数据上验证；政策引用验证结果为214/216，并非全部通过；98%可追溯性与敏感标识符移除效果均为该合成实验中的报告值，泛化能力与临床/运营部署效果尚不明确。
cards.originalTitle: Agentic AI for Healthcare Claim Denial Analysis: A Policy-Grounded Framework for Privacy Preservation

cards.descriptionEn: A prompt-optimization framework that separates reusable general rules from persona policies so the optimizer can only edit a designated block, keeping shared rules byte-stable while adapting to different analytical roles and improving reviewability and performance in financial knowledge graph construction.
cards.limitationsEn: Performance gains are not causally attributed to the block boundary; evaluation uses only ticker-disjoint 10-K splits and three personas, with OOD shift types unspecified; SME audit scale and inter-annotator agreement are not reported, and the ground-truth conclusion needs broader validation; no systematic comparison with other prompt-optimization or fine-tuning methods is provided.
cards.titleEn: FinEvolveKG: Controlled and Attributable Prompt Evolution for Financial Knowledge Graph Construction
keyPoints: FinEvolveKG将知识图谱构建提示分为字节稳定的通用块和单独版本化的角色策略块，优化器仅能修改后者，使每次编辑可定位、可审查。
在三个角色、三个种子及分布外偏移评估中，完整两阶段约束工作流（v4）较冻结基线（v1）提升19.4–30.9%，较无约束全提示工作流（v5）提升2.2–6.4%，并在所有配对种子比较中胜出。
双盲两名领域专家（SME）审计在70.1%的对比增强判断中偏好v4，另一项SME审计支持将生成的三元组用作地面真值。
cards.description: 提出一种将通用规则与角色策略分离的提示优化框架，使优化器仅能修改指定块，在保持共享规则字节稳定的同时适配不同分析角色，提升金融知识图谱构建的可审查性与性能。
cards.title: FinEvolveKG：可控可溯源的金融知识图谱提示演化
cards.whyItMatters: 为金融机构在共享知识图谱规则下低成本适配不同分析角色提供了可审查、可追溯的提示优化路径，避免无约束演化破坏共享规则，有助于降低人工提示工程与微调成本，并提升生成三元组的可信度。
cards.summary: 金融机构需从共享的SEC 10-K文件中构建知识图谱以服务风险分析、组合管理等不同需求，但手工编写角色提示和微调成本高。FinEvolveKG将提示分为可复用的通用块与角色策略块，并机械地将反射式提示优化器GEPA限制在角色策略块内，实现可归因的演化。在三个角色、多个种子和分布外偏移上，完整两阶段约束工作流（v4）在通用时序KG质量与角色相关事实、模体及多跳连通性双目标上均优于冻结提示基线（v1）和无约束全提示工作流（v5）。
keyPointsEn: FinEvolveKG separates KG-construction prompts into a byte-stable general block and separately versioned persona-policy blocks; the optimizer can only edit the latter, making each change localizable and reviewable.

Across three personas, three seeds, and OOD shifts, the complete two-stage block-constrained workflow (v4) improves 19.4–30.9% over the frozen baseline (v1) and 2.2–6.4% over the unconstrained full-prompt workflow (v5), winning all paired-seed comparisons.
A blinded two-SME audit favors v4 over v5 in 70.1% of contrast-enriched judgments, and a separate SME audit supports using the generated triplets as ground truth.
cards.summaryEn: Financial institutions build knowledge graphs from shared SEC 10-K filings to serve risk analysis, portfolio management, and other needs, but hand-authored persona prompts and fine-tuning are costly. FinEvolveKG splits prompts into a reusable general block and persona-policy blocks and mechanically confines the reflective prompt optimizer GEPA to the persona block, enabling attributable evolution. Across three personas, multiple seeds, and out-of-distribution shifts, the complete two-stage block-constrained workflow (v4) outperforms the frozen prompt baseline (v1) and the unconstrained full-prompt workflow (v5) on a dual objective balancing generic temporal-KG quality with persona-relevant facts, motifs, and multi-hop connectivity.
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a reviewable, traceable prompt-optimization path for financial institutions to adapt shared KG rules to different analytical roles at low cost, preventing unconstrained evolution from rewriting shared rules, reducing manual prompt engineering and fine-tuning effort, and increasing trust in generated triplets.
cards.limitations: 性能增益未归因于块边界约束本身；评估仅基于股票代码不相交的10-K划分和三个角色，分布外偏移类型未详述；SME审计规模与判断一致性未报告，三元组作为地面真值的结论需更广泛验证；未与其他提示优化或微调方法系统比较。
cards.originalTitle: FinEvolveKG: Controlled and Attributable Prompt Evolution for Financial Knowledge Graph Construction
